doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Tiny Kahn, radio and Your Show of Shows
title: Writing and playing for Elliot Lawrence
summary: Mandel, Cohn and Kahn wrote for and played in Elliot Lawrence's band, which Mandel says had a good conductor but no real rhythm section.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And the two of you and Al Cohn ended up writing…
Yeah, the three of you ended up writing for Elliot Lawrence a lot.
Yeah, and all played with him too.
And could afford to pay all three of you I take it?

Yeah, well, we were in the band, I started writing for the band and then later joined it. It was a nice band, Elliot let us get the guys we wanted, eventually got Al Porcino in there, got… you know Buddy Jones was playing bass, it was a nice band. We had Tiny and Buddy Jones was good we never really had a rhythm section though ‘cause Elliot was no help. Best thing Elliot ever did was conduct; he was a very good conductor.
Hell of a good conductor, that was his real talent, and a neat guy…
